What a Better Paid Advertising Brief Looks Like

Clarify your audience, offer, landing page, and measurement before your next campaign starts.

By DIGITAL ARUNSample article5 min read
IN THIS ARTICLE
Define the outcomeKnow the audienceConnect ad and destinationPlan to learn
Sample article — replace or approve before publication.

Clarify your audience, offer, landing page, and measurement before your next campaign starts.

Define the outcome

Decide what action matters: a qualified inquiry, a booked call, or another meaningful step. Make sure you can measure it.

Know the audience

Describe the customer’s situation and problem. A useful brief includes what they need to believe before they act.

Connect ad and destination

The landing page should continue the same promise made in the ad and make the next step straightforward.

Plan to learn

Set a reasonable test period and review creative, audience, and page performance together.

THE TAKEAWAY

Better growth starts with a clear customer problem, a focused action, and a way to learn from the result.
